definition: A Guardrail is a single instance of a policy or safety check evaluating an agent's input, output, or proposed action.
notes: A Guardrail always belongs to exactly one AgentRun
A Guardrail's triggered predicate reports the decision (allow, flag, or block) it reached
A Guardrail's blocked predicate is emitted in addition to triggered when the action is prevented, for consumers that only care about hard blocks
examples: A PII filter redacting or blocking output containing personal data
A content moderation check on a proposed response
A jailbreak/prompt-injection detector evaluating an input
counterExamples: The guardrail's own configuration or policy definition
A ToolCall or ModelInvocation being evaluated (see those subjects)
